key.name: hint
key.description:
A combination, never a bare modifier tap (D8): GlobalShortcuts cannot express a lone modifier press-and-release, and muvor will not promise on GNOME what it cannot keep elsewhere.
Was <Super>semicolon until 2026-08-19, when it turned out never to fire: ibus already holds that accelerator for its emoji picker (org.freedesktop.ibus.panel.emoji hotkey, alongside <Super>period). A duplicate grab is silent — addKeybinding does not throw and nothing reaches the journal — so the symptom is a hotkey that does nothing at all.
This is the right Alt in practice, but it is not *only* the right Alt: an accelerator is a keysym plus a modifier mask, and Alt_L and Alt_R both mask to Mod1. Binding one alone would need an xkb option (lv3:ralt_switch), which costs AltGr — not worth it while a second layout is installed.
